race.comment: DORALEE (3) was runner-up when resuming at Mornington in May, and was found to have had a throat issue after that run. She has had a couple of jump-outs this season at Flemington, and treks back to Sydney for her fresh up run. The wide draw is the only query for us. CAPDIVA (2) was runner-up off a freshen up here 2 weeks ago, and she will be even sharper for this suitable assignment. With luck from a wide gate, she can figure in the top 3 again. LADY TALEA (5) was less than 2 lengths from the winner when finishing third here a fortnight ago, maintaining her perfect placed record on this track. She has the pole position this time, and is overdue to break through. OLE STEELE (12) showed plenty of talent as a juvenile, and she resumes off the back of a huge win at the recent Scone trials. She is sure to be well found in the market. Can win.
